Logic Analysis: CMakeLists.txt
dependency/build; declares core static library from non-Main sources, demo runtime target, and single test target; enables testing and registers the test
include/Tokens.h
interface; declares TokenType enum, Token struct with position, and non-inline operator helper function declarations (precedence, associativity, operator-char) used by Lexer/Parser
src/Tokens.cpp
domain-entity; implements non-inline Token-related helpers (precedence(char), isLeftAssociative(char), isOperatorChar(char))
include/Lexer.h
interface; declares LexResult (success, tokens, error message/position) and class Lexer with tokenize(const std::string&) const
src/Lexer.cpp
pure-rule; implements whitespace skipping, numeric (decimal) scanning, parentheses and operator tokenization, with position-aware error reporting
include/Parser.h
interface; declares ParseResult (success, RPN tokens, error message/position) and class Parser with toRPN(const std::vector<Token>&) const
src/Parser.cpp
pure-rule; implements shunting-yard algorithm with precedence/associativity from Tokens helpers, validates parentheses, and produces RPN or error with position
include/Evaluator.h
interface; declares EvalResult (success, value, error message/position) and class Evaluator with evaluateRPN(const std::vector<Token>&) const
src/Evaluator.cpp
pure-rule; implements stack-based RPN execution; checks operand availability and division-by-zero, reports errors with source position from operator tokens
include/History.h
interface; declares HistoryEntry (expression, result) and class History with record(expr,value), entries() const, and clear()
src/History.cpp
domain-entity; implements History using std::vector<HistoryEntry>; records only successful evaluations
include/Calculator.h
interface; declares EvaluationOutcome (success, value, error message/position) and class Calculator orchestrating tokenization, parsing, evaluation, and history
src/Calculator.cpp
orchestration; implements Calculator::evaluate() workflow: Lexer -> Parser -> Evaluator, records history on success, returns EvaluationOutcome
src/Main.cpp
runtime/bootstrap; thin, deterministic demo that evaluates a few fixed expressions and prints results/errors; no interactive loop
tests/test_main.cpp
automated-test; single protocol-level test file that includes only include/Calculator.h and performs concise API-level smoke and representative rule tests
Shared Knowledge:
This repository builds a pure, testable core library exposing a single canonical public API in include/Calculator.h. Domain modules are split into token model, lexer, parser (shunting-yard to RPN), evaluator (RPN execution), and history. The demo runtime entry is src/Main.cpp. The single test file tests/test_main.cpp includes only include/Calculator.h. CMake builds a core static library from non-Main src/*.cpp files, links both the runtime demo and the test executable against that library, enables testing, and registers the test.

The full normative architecture prompt above is binding for every generated file and test.
